_comment: Default thresholds for the Weekly Report callout + recommendation engine. Override per-brand via --config with the same schema (deep-merged over these).

buy_box._low_bb_threshold: Flag an ASIN's Buy Box as 'lost' below this share (0-1). Raise toward 0.9 for brands that should always own the box.

inventory._weeks_of_cover_warning: Flag OOS risk when on-hand / (T4 weekly velocity) is below this many weeks.
inventory._min_weekly_ops_for_oos_flag: Only raise an OOS callout for ASINs above this weekly OPS — avoids noise from long-tail SKUs.

statistical._z_threshold: Weekly metric is called out when |z| vs the trailing 12-week mean exceeds this. Raise to 2.0 for highly seasonal brands.

advertising._roas_warning_threshold: ROAS below this is treated as a warning in callouts/recs.
advertising._portfolio_scale_roas: Recommend scaling a non-default portfolio when its ROAS exceeds this.

pricing._asp_yoy_callout_pct: Call out ASP movement when |YoY %| exceeds this.

display._top_asins_count: How many ASINs the Products table shows. Lower to 8-10 for thin catalogs.
display._asin_name_maxlen: Cap (chars) for the deterministic ASIN label produced by clean_name() at load.
